Cultural and employee engagement activities:  Very less, twice in a year maybe some competitions happen, but leaders of teams don’t involve everyone. They show favouritism.They collected cash for these programmes and even for onam sadya ! Company can’t even pay for onam sadya! 10 days per month is the work from office policy, so we are not even meeting our teammates often , so basically most days, we feel lonely.

reviews.title: rated by a Softwaretest Engineer in Chennai
reviews.pros: Apart from work culture, fixed weekly day off, and better food, I don't have anything positive about Infosys(Trivandrum DC)
reviews.cons:
I worked in Trivandrum DC. If you want to be allocated to projects quickly and safeguard your job, please don't go for Trivandrum DC. The projects are too low, and the probability of getting layoffs in this DC is high. They just laidoff without any prior notice and told us to leave the company by EOD. I've been in the project for many months and contributed a lot. But all of a sudden, they laid off without any prior notice or notice period. They said that the final settlement will be provided and the relevant letter will be provided, but we didn't get any. NO FINAL SETTLEMENTS NO RELEVING LETTER/EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE. When I tried to contact them, there was no proper response from them, and each of them is pointing out somebody and trying to escape. The CEO told his employees to work more than 70-72 hours to grow his company, but he never cared about his employees and their families. This is what I got after working in Infosys for 3+ years. Better not go to Infosys. If you want to, don't choose Trivandrum DC; better go to Bangalore, Chennai, or Hyderabad DC.
They even ask us the monthly fare for the shuttle bus, even small IT companies provide free pick up and drop off, but this MNC(I don't think so) is asking the employees to pay the monthly fare for the shuttle bus. I think may be they are shortage of money, that's the reason. For the past few years, they have stuck to 3.6LPA for freshers, don't even upgrade their salary package for freshers, but they need money from us in the form of services they are providing. What a pity!
